roster.emptyHint: Create a companion and choose its models here to start chatting. Set up knowledge bases and custom figures on the desktop.
roster.loadFailed: Failed to load the companion roster

overview.chatModelMissingBody: Choose a main chat model under Models below. Existing sessions can still be opened; change their model from the chat page.
overview.learnHint: A pass reviews recently collected events and distils memories and skills; collection toggles live on the desktop.
overview.skillsCount: {{count}} skills in total — the full list and SKILL.md bodies are on the desktop.
overview.robotsHint: Binding and unbinding are done on the desktop.
overview.skillDraftsHint: Skills the companion drafted by itself. They only take effect once accepted.
overview.skillRejectBody: The draft is archived and never activated, and the companion stops proposing it from the same pattern again. This cannot be undone, but you can still create the skill by hand on the desktop.
overview.skillRejectReasonHint: A reason helps the companion propose fewer skills like this one.
overview.chatFailed: Could not open chat. Please try again.
overview.learnModelMissing: Choose a learning model under Models first.
overview.learnNoEvents: No new events to learn from

memory.emptyHint: Turn on collection and run a learning pass on the desktop, or just note something here.
memory.emptyFilteredHint: Try another keyword or relax the filters.
memory.composeKindHint: The kind decides how this memory is weighted and decays during retrieval. It belongs to this companion only.
memory.pinHint: Pinned memories never decay and are always retrieved first.
memory.deleteConfirmBody: This memory is deleted permanently and cannot be recovered.

settings.nameHint: What your companion is called — shown in chat and on the desktop companion
settings.personaCustomPlaceholder: Extra persona notes (optional), e.g. call me "Captain"
settings.quietHint: It stays quiet during this window; overnight ranges work too (e.g. 23:00 to 08:00).
settings.deskVisibleHint: Show this companion on the desktop (transparent always-on-top window, desktop only)
settings.learnEnabledHint: Reviews recent events every {{minutes}} minutes and distils memories and skills
settings.desktopOnlyBody: Figures and the figure library, knowledge-base bindings, and migration import/export are configured on the desktop.
settings.deleteHint: Permanently delete “{{name}}” together with its memories, skills, growth progress and chat history.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: The settings, every memory, the skills, the growth progress and the chat history of “{{name}}” are all deleted permanently and cannot be recovered.

create.title: New companion
create.hint: After creating it, configure models, add memories and start chatting here. Set up knowledge bases and custom figures on the desktop.

detail.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted — go back to the roster.
detail.refreshFailed: Could not refresh. Showing the last confirmed settings.

hints.model: Sets the companion default for newly created sessions. Change an existing session model from its chat page.
hints.fallback_model: Select a dedicated fallback chat model for this companion, or clear the selection.
hints.vision_model: Used for independent image understanding. When unset, the main chat model is used if its protocol supports images.
hints.asr: Override speech recognition for this companion. Clear to follow the global speech recognition settings.
hints.tts: Override text to speech and voice for this companion. Clear to follow the global text to speech settings.
hints.learn: Used for companion learning, independently of the main chat model.
hints.evolve: Used for companion skill evolution, independently of the main chat model.

modelSettings.defaultHint: These are the companion defaults. Change the model of an existing session from its chat page.
